Name: Steam Surge
Description: A blast of boiling air erupts from your hands. Each creature in a 20-foot cone must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 4d8 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. This damage cannot be resisted as a result of being underwater.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level.
